modes.unpublish: return to draft with complete payload

article.bodyEncoding: JSON array containing one payload object
article.coverImage: current media record object; never assume URL-only shape; readback comparison uses the canonical persisted field subset
article.content: Slate node array; never Markdown or HTML string
article.createPayloadRule: 2026-09-04 stable create payload B1/B2: postCreate accepts exactly the 8 contract fields plus siteId (missing and extra fields are refused; the update-path merge semantics are unchanged). coverImage must be null or flat media: URL media (name, type='image', source='url', absolute http/https url; never path/size/mimeType) or OSS media (name, type='image', source='oss', path, non-negative integer size, mimeType; never url); a string/null alt is normalized to missing; the {type,value} editor wrapper is readback-only and refused on the write path. The one prepared snapshot (prepareStableCreatePayload in content-mutation-primitives.mjs) plus its immutable canonical payloadText are the request payload, the authorization payload_digest input (SHA-256 over the exact UTF-8 payloadText), and the native wire body [payloadText]; the host driver prepares synchronously before any await/provider/auth and the bottom layer re-prepares idempotently. The adapter's byte guarantee ends at the input of the host request callback.
article.coverImagePayloadRule: for the current deployment profile, every non-null coverImage payload must own name, alt, type, source, path, size, and mimeType before any request; URL-only and partial objects fail closed; extra media fields may be submitted but are not required in readback
article.jsonComparison: compare normalized JSON value/type semantics only; browser/CDP realm prototypes are not contract fields

contentFormatProfile.recommendedAuthoringSource: Markdown converted deterministically before payload construction

unsupportedCurrentShape.observed: API response and exact backend readback succeeded, but editor reopen failed
unsupportedCurrentShape.policy: recover to the previous last-known-good content and do not publish the tested shape

markdownRules.h1: reject; article title owns the page H1
markdownRules.table: simple equal-width GFM table with at least one body row; alignment markers are rejected because the verified Slate shape has no alignment field

category.childRule: parent is the current parent category ID

tag.duplicateSlugRule: block before request for the same site; every snapshot record must carry an explicit proven siteId, and missing siteId fails closed

taxonomy.readbackContentTypeRule: on the exact /posts taxonomy route, omitted contentType is interpreted as route-scoped posts only after exact site context is proven; any explicit non-posts value fails closed

recovery.safeRetryRule: only one controlled retry after an explicit fresh exact-absence confirmation; readback null alone is insufficient
recovery.batchRule: strict serial; skip completed keys; stop on first unresolved result
recovery.createRule: postCreate is canonical only under the Registry fresh-qualification gate: before any request, createPostDraft requires a current runtime action contract, an exact payload_digest authorization context, a duplicate-free beforePostIds snapshot, and the readback/getCreatedPostId/getCreatedPostSiteId/getAfterPostIds/editorReopen callbacks; after the single request, the readback must prove the exact expected fields, a non-empty created post ID, same-site ownership, a before/after snapshot difference of exactly one ID, and that the created ID equals that sole new ID; success additionally requires editorReopen(createdPostId) to return {status:200, authenticated:true, healthy:true, postId:<same>}, otherwise the result is stopped_manual_intervention; no automatic retry is allowed (maxControlledRetries must be 0) because the request may already have created the draft
recovery.existingArticleRule: postUpdate and taxonomy mutations never retry merely because a readback is null

create: duplicate-free before snapshot of same-site post IDs taken before the request
exactly one new post ID in the after snapshot
created post ID equals the sole new ID and belongs to the exact site
exact expected field readback on the created record
editor reopen returns {status:200, authenticated:true, healthy:true, postId:<created>}
no automatic retry after the request has started
publishedThemeWarnings: backend Slate image alt persistence does not prove frontend theme img alt propagation
backend category/tag binding does not prove the theme visibly renders taxonomy
record theme presentation gaps as WARN without rewriting backend persistence as failure
